notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Forest Lookouts page gives only the survey designation, county, agency and quadrangle; its survey description reads 'NO STATION DESCRIPTION AVAILABLE', so there is no design, height, build date or status. The NGS record gives the same name and coordinates. Mapcarta is a crowd-sourced map listing and adds only that a tower exists in Calhoun. Two web searches and a few reads found nothing else; the Encyclopedia of Arkansas and the Arkansas index page do not mention this tower. The story runs about 125 words, the length this thin record supports. Brief checks: county, coordinates (33.43, -92.4528) and agency agree with the sources; no corrections. The designation 'TWR 3 6' is copied as published and not interpreted.
